snippet.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Modern Warfare 4 releases on October 23, 2026.

The Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 Reveal Trailer gives players their first official look at the next chapter of the Modern Warfare series. The trailer introduces a global conflict sparked by a full-scale invasion of the Korean Peninsula, following a squad of South Korean soldiers fighting on the front lines while Captain Price pursues a dangerous off-book mission. Players get an early look at the campaign's story, cinematic action, diverse combat environments, and the escalating threats driving Modern Warfare 4.

Key Takeaways
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 continues the Modern Warfare series with a new global conflict.
The Reveal Trailer introduces the campaign's story, characters, and tone.
Players get their first look at large-scale military operations across multiple locations.
Missions include trench warfare, covert raids, urban combat, vehicle chases, and close-quarters engagements.
Captain Price returns as a central character pursuing a personal mission.
The trailer showcases cinematic storytelling and grounded military action.
"Going Dark" signals the return of tactical covert operations.
The "Six Days Earlier" sequence hints at the events leading into the campaign.
The trailer reveals the official release date and teases additional Modern Warfare 4 content.

Questions Answered
00:56 What campaign missions and combat scenarios are shown?
01:10 What does "Going Dark" mean in Modern Warfare 4?
01:16 What does the "Six Days Earlier" timeline reveal?
01:38 Which locations are featured in the Modern Warfare 4 campaign?
02:12 What gameplay and combat styles are showcased?
02:42 When does Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 release?
02:46 What editions and additional content are revealed?

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 expands the series with a new global conflict, cinematic campaign missions, and tactical military action across multiple locations. The Reveal Trailer introduces the story, characters, and gameplay while offering players their first official look at the next Modern Warfare experience.

Learn more about Call of Duty: https://www.callofduty.com/
